# Supreme Bot

> Multi-tenant Discord bot SaaS platform by Carbon Stealth VCC. Provides ticket systems, application forms, AI auto-replies via Anthropic Claude, white-label custom bots, verification, automation, analytics, and a public REST API. EU-hosted, GDPR-compliant by design.

Carbon Stealth VCC is an EU-registered software company (EIK BG208725180) headquartered in Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, with an office in Sofia. Supreme Bot is one of several digital products in our portfolio. The platform serves Discord communities, esports organizations, customer support teams, agencies, and content creators worldwide.

Pricing: Free tier (1 panel, 2 forms with up to 5 questions, 1 verification panel, persistent transcripts with 30-day retention) and Premium (€9.99/server/month with up to 50 panels, 50 forms and 50 questions, AI replies, white-label bot, 14-day free trial without credit card).

## Features

- [Ticket System](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/#features-tickets): Visual button panels, automatic channel creation, round-robin staff assignment, persistent HTML transcripts that survive Discord channel deletion
- [Application Forms](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/#features-forms): Logic-branching questionnaires, multi-step flows, built-in review dashboard, auto-role grant on approval
- [White-Label Custom Bots](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/#features-whitelabel): Premium feature allowing customers to upload their own Discord bot token; the platform runs the bot under the customer's own brand
- [AI Auto-Replies](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/#features-ai): Premium feature using Anthropic Claude for context-aware first-response replies; EU AI Act Article 50 disclosure compliant
- [Verification System](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/#features-verification): Captcha-based bot/troll prevention with account age requirements and auto-role on success
- [Automation Engine](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/#features-automation): If-this-then-that workflows with event triggers, action chains, and conditional logic
- [Public REST API](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/#features-api): Bearer-token authentication for building custom integrations and dashboards
- [Webhook Integrations](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/#features-webhooks): HMAC-signed outgoing webhooks on every platform event

## Compliance and infrastructure

- [GDPR Privacy Settings](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/dashboard/privacy-settings): Self-service data export (Articles 15+20), account deletion (Article 17), consent withdrawal (Article 7.3)
- [Robots policy](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/robots.txt): AI crawler permissions (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended allowed; CCBot and Bytespider blocked)
- [Sitemap](https://supreme.carbonstealth.eu/sitemap.xml): Complete URL inventory with last-modified dates
